rationale: Suspicious: 1 signal(s) needing review; e.g. full-viewport transparent / pointer-event overlay.

findings.title: Full-viewport transparent / pointer-event overlay
findings.detail: A positioned, fully-transparent <div> — a clickjacking/overlay shell pattern.

limitations: Static heuristic scan. A GOOD verdict means no known-bad pattern matched, NOT proof of safety. Human review is still required for every submission.
